A worked example with the NLSY79 wage data
Introductory Econometrics
Road map
The wage data we use in the lab is a panel : 36 , 908 observations on 5 , 198 men, each seen about
seven times. That single fact drives everything in this note. Ability — the classic omitted
variable in a wage regression — does not change over time, so it is exactly the unit effect c i of
Core Notes 3. We first measure the omitted variable bias directly, by putting the AFQT score
in and taking it out. We then ask what the panel estimators of Core Notes 3 would do instead,
and find that the obvious answer does not work here — for a reason worth understanding.
